limitations.stats: Unconditional SetDefaults values before player, difficulty, global hooks and configuration.
limitations.recipes: Static registration expressions; loops, inherited helpers and post-registration recipe edits require source inspection.
limitations.drops: Known rules are conditional. World/chest/shop references are not guarantees of availability.
limitations.spawns: Calamity conditions come from SpawnChance and related source checks; vanilla Terraria environment/type fields come from Terraria Wiki infoboxes. Dynamic event timing, luck and multiplayer scaling are not converted into a single percentage.
